name: SET domain containing 2, histone lysine methyltransferase

function.text: SETD2 encodes histone-lysine N-methyltransferase SETD2. Annotated molecular activities include protein-lysine N-methyltransferase activity and histone H3 methyltransferase activity. It participates in mismatch repair and regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to SETD2-related neurodevelopmental disorder without or with macrocephaly/overgrowth (autosomal dominant); SETD2-related microcephaly-severe intellectual disability-multiple congenital anomalies syndrome (autosomal dominant). Additional curated associations are listed below.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Mesothelioma; Collecting duct carcinoma; Hepatosplenic T-cell lymphoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
